newsitem.title: CANADA: Fire hits Suncor refinery in Ontario.
newsitem.headline: Fire hits Suncor refinery in Ontario.

text.p: A fire in the early hours of Sunday morning in the alkylation unit of Suncor Inc's Sunoco refinery in Sarnia, Ontario, has forced the refinery to shut down about eight percent of its output, said Mike Asher, vice-president of the refinery.
The fire, which began at around 0300 EDT/0700 GMT, was quickly extinguished, Asher said in a telephone interview.
"(The unit) is shut down now and we will be looking at that unit and attempting to get back up as son as we are able to," Asher said.
Eight workers were sent to the hospital for observation but were quickly released, Asher said. Suncor will be investigating the cause of the fire, he added.
